QuestInfo.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
QuestInfo.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter
QuestInfo.0: It seems that #p506#, having regained her memories of the past, is eager to share the news with her father.
QuestInfo.1: Amazingly, #p506# recovered from her amnesia with the help of her toy sword. It was amazing! The only thing left now is for #p506# and #p206# to finally reunite. But first, I have to get this letter from #p506# back to #p206#.
QuestInfo.2: I was so glad that #p506# got her memory back. I was even gladder that #p206# finally got to see his daughter again! How touching...

0.0: Please give this letter to my dad! I can't believe it! I can't wait to see my dad again!

1.0: Oh... that's... my... daughter... indeed... I... can't believe it... I don't think I've ever been so happy in my life... Thank you so much.
1.1: I am so glad my daughter is alive and well! I have to make my way there now. I cannot wait to see her. Here's some money for your traveling expenses. It may not be much, but please take it.

yes.0: This is too good to be true!

lost.0: I'll write it again here. Please take care of it! Don't lose it this time!
